info.name: Sohar Bank
info.description:
Sohar Bank - insurance APIs on the Uponly tenant. One working example per product (UPPA001, TL001, FP001, HC001, CI001, LP001, DH001), each a 13-step flow (plans, proposal, enrolment, issue, load policy, reject, documents, cancel check, cancel approve), plus common utility APIs and the staff-portal APIs (me, worklist, dashboard, share, cancel-detail).

Setup: select the Sohar Bank environment, set username and password, run '0. Get Token' (stores the ticket in `token`; every request uses it as Bearer auth, the collection also re-fetches it automatically when empty). Dates and ApplicationNo are generated; ProposalNo / PolicyNo are filled by test scripts. All product, plan and insured values are collection variables named <PRODUCT>_<field>. No VAT. Every request carries ChannelCode = {{channelCode}} (SOHAR). Every proposal carries OrgCode = {{orgCode}} (1, a branch known to the platform): without it the platform cannot validate the cancellation. Cancel Approve in the saved flow uses Decision APPROVE (the policy becomes Cancelled and the refund is returned); send REJECT to close the request and keep the policy in force.

Access: role checks are switched off (UP_ApiConfig RoleEnforcement = N). Any user or machine user that can obtain a platform token can call every API; no role rows are needed. Examples were re-run live on 2026-10-07 (MC tenant).

exec: // Unique ApplicationNo, refreshed every 30 min so re-runs do not collide.

pm.sendRequest({url: pm.variables.get('casUrl')+'/cas/ebao/v2/json/tickets', method:'POST', header:{'Content-Type':'application/json','x-mo-user-source-id':'platform','x-mo-tenant-id':pm.variables.get('tenant')}, body:{mode:'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({username: pm.variables.get('username'), password: pm.variables.get('password')})}}, function(err,res){
var t = pm.response.text(); var tok = null;
try { var j = JSON.parse(t); tok = j.access_token || j.token || j.ticket || j.Token || (j.data && (j.data.access_token || j.data.token || j.data.ticket)); } catch(e) { tok = t.trim(); }

request.description: Fetches a CAS ticket and stores it in `token`. Set `username` and `password` first (not stored in this collection). Re-run on 401.
